items.question: Which additional embodied yoginī forms share devotional knowledge on earth?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate beings who know through devotion on earth.
This verse continues that enumeration with further named feminine forms.
Disjunctive and additive particles present these forms as included alternatives.
items.inference: Additional embodied yoginī forms are likewise included among those possessing devotional knowledge on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identities or species associations of pecakī, sararī, and gūlī are not fully determined from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The owl-woman, or indeed the peacock-woman, or the sararī-woman, or the gūlī-woman likewise.
